meta.title: Open stats · Pyreon
meta.description: Pyreon in numbers, live: GitHub stars, contributors, issues, releases and npm downloads, plus the benchmark record with every withdrawn claim.

hero.title: Built in the open. Counted in public.
hero.lede: Every number on this page is pulled from GitHub, npm and the repository on each daily deploy. Nobody types them in and nobody rounds them up.

benchmarks.title: Every claim in one record, losses included.
benchmarks.text: Every performance claim Pyreon makes is in one record, with the method, the machine and the cases where another framework wins. A number that turns out wrong is withdrawn in the record itself, with the reason, and the history keeps every edit.
